a: chain connects multiple iterables end to end.
islice slices an iterator without converting to a list.
compress filters items using a selector iterable.
accumulate yields running totals or other binary reductions.
deque supports fast appends/pops from both ends.
ChainMap groups multiple mappings into one view.
heapq implements a binary heap priority queue.
bisect maintains sorted lists via binary search insertion.
array stores compact typed numeric sequences.
